entry.title: EDrum Kit 1.0.0
entry.summary: First release. Roland V-Drums (TD-27 with VH-14D / PD-140DS / CY-18DR) playing the MPC's own kits on a standalone MPC (MPC OS 3.10.1+). Install: unzip and copy the 'burgerbarn - VST - EDrum Kit' folder into 'VST2 Plugins' on an MPC drive, then enable Enhancements → External Plugin Support. Demo: https://www.youtube.com/shorts/BulFtb2QcNA
